name: Utah
overview: Utah has owner and renter circuit-breaker programs with different assessment, income and claim-year timing.

programs.name: Homeowner's Circuit Breaker Credit and Valuation Reduction
programs.ageRule: 66 or older in 2025, or qualifying surviving spouse.
programs.incomeDefinition: Gross household income under the homeowner-credit rules. The 2024 income reference for 2025 relief is inferred from the prior-year rule in 2026 guidance; the exact 2025 TC-90CY form remains unavailable.
programs.incomeLimits: Less than $42,623 for the 2025 homeowner application.
programs.maximumBenefit: Income-based credit up to $1,312, plus tax on 20% of the residence's fair market value.
programs.formulaSummary: Income-band credit and separate home-value-based reduction, limited by qualifying taxes.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year Utah residency and own financial support.
programs.programYear: 2025 property tax; the 2024 household-income reference remains inferred rather than verified against the 2025 form.

programs.name: Renter Credit / Renter Refund
programs.ageRule: 66 or older, or unmarried surviving spouse.
programs.incomeDefinition: 2025 total household income for refund of 2025 rent, claimed in 2026.
programs.formulaSummary: Income-band percentage of eligible gross rent with corresponding refund caps; not a single fixed property-tax rent proxy.
programs.application: File TC-90CB or TAP application by December 31, 2026.

sources.title: TC-90CB refund for rent year 2025, revision April 2026

programs.name: Low-income / Indigent Abatement
programs.incomeDefinition: Household income under the county abatement rules; the precise income definition is not established.
programs.maximumBenefit: Half of qualifying taxes, capped at $1,312 under the 2025 table.
programs.formulaSummary: County-discretionary abatement with separate eligibility and application requirements.
programs.programYear: 2025 property tax; county application due September 1, 2025.

laterChanges: 2026 homeowner rules introduce age-67 or prior-year eligibility conditions; these are separate from the 2025 homeowner baseline.
researchNotes: The $1,412 renter refund applies to 2025 rent claimed in 2026. The 2025 homeowner table has a separate $1,312 maximum.
The forms index does not establish the 2025 homeowner income reference year. Its 2024-income mapping remains inferred from later guidance.

sources.title: TC-90CB refund for rent year 2025, revision April 2026
